<subject>Re: ENE</subject>

- Alexandre

<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Ruiz, Aimé <aime.ruiz@lumieresante.fr>
Sent: Tuesday, November 4, 2025 8:24 AM
To: "René" <rene.bourgeois@tanmargroup.com>; Bonnin, Alexandre
Subject: RE: ENE

Hello:

What about Thu the following week?  
I am going to Clinique Sainte-Anne on the 15th.

Aimé

-----Original Message-----
From: "René" <rene.bourgeois@tanmargroup.com>  
Sent: Monday, November 3, 2025 6:04 PM
To: Bonnin, Alexandre; Ruiz, Aimé
Subject: Re: ENE

Hey,

11/15 sounds good, everybody pencil it in. We'll confirm as day gets nearer, and if Alexandre wants to go somewhere that serves Jeanne Bazin, that is fine by me also:)

Isaac
----- Original Message -----
From: "Bonnin, Alexandre" <alexandre.bonnin@lumieresante.fr>
To: "Ruiz, Aimé" <aime.ruiz@lumieresante.fr>; <rene.bourgeois@tanmargroup.com>
Sent: Monday, November 3, 2025 1:56 PM
Subject: RE: ENE


Aimé & Isaac,

I'm available any time for dinner other than Mondays or Wednesdays (taking Jeanne at Rice)

Thursdays are best, then tuesdays next.

This week, though, taking off Thursday after work to visit my dad in Montvalard, so gone Friday too.

Even fridays generally OK, though I'd need to bring Isabelle Charrier!

Jeanne Charrier: How about next Thursday 11/15????

Also, the earlier the better........(office hours 5am-4pm)

looking forward to it......


--- Alexandre
